stories.headline: Instacart Co-Founder Launches Abundance, AI-Agent-Run Hedge Fund With $100M Seed Funding

key_facts.fact: Instacart co-founder Apoorva Mehta launched Abundance, a hedge fund that aims to have AI agents handle the entire investment process, with $100 million in seed funding.
Abundance is described as having a fully integrated AI stack for scientific and technical underwriting, evaluated against frontier LLMs.
Dimension Capital, an existing investor, partnered on the fund, alongside backers including Laksh Aithani and Oleksiy Shavlov as co-founders.

stories.headline: Sam Altman Apologizes for Not Alerting Police About Mass Shooting Suspect's ChatGPT Activity

key_facts.fact: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman apologized to a Canadian town for not notifying police about a mass shooting suspect's troubling ChatGPT account activity when her account was suspended.
Altman said he was 'deeply sorry' and pledged closer work with governments to prevent future tragedies.
The mass shooting occurred in February in Canada; OpenAI had suspended the suspect's account but did not report the activity to law enforcement.

stories.headline: Anthropic's Project Deal Shows AI Agent Quality Creates Invisible Economic Inequality in Marketplaces

key_facts.fact: Anthropic ran a marketplace experiment with 69 employees where Claude agents bought, sold, and negotiated personal belongings; agents completed 186 deals worth over $4,000 total.
In a secret parallel experiment, users with the frontier model Claude Opus 4.5 completed ~2 more deals on average than those with the smaller Claude Haiku 4.5.
When the same item was sold by Opus instead of Haiku, it went for $3.64 more on average; Opus sellers extracted $2.68 more per item and Opus buyers paid $2.45 less.
Users with worse-performing agents did not notice their disadvantage; perceived fairness scores were nearly identical (4.05 for Opus deals vs 4.06 for Haiku) on a 7-point scale.
Aggressive user instructions made no statistically significant difference on outcomes; what mattered was which model represented you, not how you told it to negotiate.
46% of participants said they would pay for a similar AI agent commerce service in the future.

stories.headline: Brazil Blocks 28 Prediction Market Platforms Including Polymarket and Kalshi

key_facts.fact: Brazil blocked 28 prediction market platforms including Polymarket and Kalshi, Finance Minister Dario Durigan announced Friday in Brasilia
Durigan said the platforms are not in compliance with betting regulations approved by Congress and therefore violate the law
Brazil also tightened derivatives rules to curb 'bet-like' financial products alongside the platform blocks
The move comes as the US CFTC simultaneously sued New York for overstepping its authority by targeting prediction market operators Coinbase and Gemini

stories.headline: ComfyUI Raises $30M at $500M Valuation as Open-Source AI Media Tool Hits 4 Million Users

key_facts.fact: ComfyUI raised $30 million at a $500 million valuation, bringing total funding to $47 million. The round was led by Craft Ventures with Pace Capital, Chemistry, and TruArrow.
The open-source tool has over 4 million users and 60,000+ community-built nodes, with 150,000+ daily downloads.
ComfyUI's node-based interface gives creators granular control over every step of image, video, and audio generation from diffusion models, unlike prompt-based tools.
Funding will go toward Comfy Cloud for enterprise, collaborative workflows, local experience improvements, and day-one support for new model releases.

stories.headline: DOJ Joins xAI's Lawsuit to Block Colorado's AI Antidiscrimination Law on First Amendment Grounds

key_facts.fact: The US Department of Justice joined xAI's lawsuit arguing Colorado's SB 24-205 jeopardizes the US position as 'the global AI leader' by requiring AI systems to incorporate discriminatory ideology
DOJ attorneys filed a 19-page complaint in federal court in Denver claiming the law violates the First and 14th Amendments
xAI's original suit, filed April 9, argues the law would force its chatbot Grok to 'abandon its disinterested pursuit of truth and instead promote the State's ideological views'
Colorado's law is set to go into effect June 30 after being pushed back from February to allow further negotiation
The DOJ complaint claims the law imposes 'onerous policy, assessment, and disclosure requirements that will disproportionately burden small businesses and start-ups'

stories.headline: ESA Demolishes Russian Soyuz Rocket Launch Complex in French Guiana, MaiaSpace to Reuse 80% of Site

key_facts.fact: The European Space Agency carried out a controlled explosion of the 52-meter mobile service tower at the Soyuz-ST launch complex at the Kourou spaceport in French Guiana on April 24
Prior to the demolition, the 'tulip' — four truss supports that held the rocket before launch — and cable masts had already been cut
MaiaSpace, a French startup affiliated with Arianespace, plans to reuse up to 80% of the existing infrastructure for its own launch vehicle program
MaiaSpace is developing a two-stage rocket powered by Prometheus methane-fueled engines, with the first launch scheduled for 2027
The demolition ends a 15-year cooperation program between ESA and Roscosmos known as 'Soyuz at Kourou'

stories.headline: FDA Grants Priority Review Vouchers to Three Psychedelic Drug Programs, First Approval Possible by Summer

key_facts.fact: The FDA awarded national priority vouchers to Compass Pathways (psilocybin for treatment-resistant depression), Usona Institute (psilocybin for major depressive disorder), and Transcend Therapeutics (methylone for PTSD)
FDA Commissioner Marty Makary said the first psychedelic drug could be approved in the US as soon as this summer
The vouchers cut FDA review time from a year to just 1-2 months after an application is filed
Compass Pathways' COMP360 phase 3 trial with over 1,000 participants showed effects within a day that lasted at least six months for clinically meaningful responders
The action came days after Trump signed an executive order to accelerate access to psychedelic mental health treatments
Critics say the program was put in place without congressional input and could undermine trust in FDA's regulatory process

stories.headline: Google Plans Up to $40B Investment in Anthropic at $350B Valuation, With 5GW of Compute

key_facts.fact: Google is committing $10 billion now in cash at a $350 billion valuation, with another $30 billion to follow if Anthropic hits certain performance targets.
Google Cloud will provide 5 gigawatts of TPU-based compute capacity over the next five years, with room to scale further.
Anthropic's valuation stood at $350 billion in February; investors have since been eager to back the company at $800 billion or more. The company is reportedly considering an IPO as soon as October.
The deal expands a prior Anthropic-Google-Broadcom partnership for TPU-based compute that a Broadcom filing put at 3.5 gigawatts.
Anthropic also recently secured $5 billion from Amazon, committing to spend $100 billion on AWS over 10 years, and struck a separate deal with CoreWeave for data center capacity.

stories.headline: Intel Surges 23.6% in Best Day Since 1987; US Government Stake Quadruples to ~$36B

key_facts.fact: Intel stock soared 23.6% to close at $82.73, its best close ever, surpassing the previous record of $74.88 set on August 31, 2000
The daily gain was Intel's biggest since October 29, 1987, when it soared 26%
Intel is up 87% for April, adding more than $190 billion to market value
The value of the US government's stake in Intel has increased fourfold to about $36 billion from an August 2025 announcement of $8.9B
Intel's foundry segment still posted a $2.44 billion operating loss in Q1 despite turnaround gains elsewhere

stories.headline: Maine Governor Vetoes First US State Moratorium on Data Center Construction

key_facts.fact: Maine Gov. Janet Mills vetoed LD 307, which would have frozen approvals for data centers requiring more than 20MW until October 2027
Mills said she supports the moratorium concept but vetoed because the bill lacked an exemption for a $550M data center project in Jay, a distressed mill town
The Jay data center project would create more than 800 construction jobs and at least 100 permanent jobs at a former paper mill site that shut in 2023
More than a dozen US states are weighing legislation to halt or restrain data center development, including Virginia
Both chambers of Maine's Legislature had passed the bill; Mills also signed a separate bill excluding data centers from state business tax incentives

stories.headline: Meta Signs Multibillion-Dollar Deal for Tens of Millions of Amazon Graviton Cores for AI Inference

key_facts.fact: Meta signed a multibillion-dollar, multiyear deal to bring tens of millions of AWS Graviton CPU cores into its compute portfolio for AI inference workloads.
Graviton is an ARM-based CPU, not a GPU; agentic AI workloads like real-time reasoning, coding, and multi-step task coordination are driving demand for CPUs alongside GPUs.
Amazon's custom chip business is already generating $20 billion per year in revenue.
Meta plans to spend $115B–$135B in capital expenditure in 2026, up from ~$72B last year.
The deal competes with GPU-focused chips; Anthropic already locked up Amazon's Trainium AI GPUs in a $100 billion, 10-year deal announced earlier this month.

stories.headline: Nvidia Closes at Record High, Pushing Market Cap Past $5 Trillion for First Time Since October

key_facts.fact: Nvidia shares rose 4.3% to close at $208.27, a new all-time high, pushing its market cap past $5 trillion — only the second company in history to reach that mark.
The rally was sparked by Intel's blowout earnings, which sent Intel shares up 24% — their best day since 1987 — and AMD up 14%.
Nvidia is up more than 14-fold since the end of 2022, driven by soaring demand for AI infrastructure from Google, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon, OpenAI, and Anthropic.
The Nasdaq is up 15% in April, headed for its best month since April 2020.

stories.headline: Related Digital Secures $16B Financing for Oracle AI Data Center Campus in Michigan

key_facts.fact: Related Digital secured $16 billion in financing for a giant data center campus in Saline Township, Michigan for Oracle
Related Digital and funds affiliated with Blackstone committed equity; fixed-rate, long-term debt financing was anchored by PIMCO-managed funds
Bank of America sold $14 billion in bonds as part of the financing after months of stop-and-start negotiations
Oracle plans to use the Michigan campus to power applications for OpenAI

stories.headline: S&P 500 and Nasdaq Close at Record Highs as Intel Surges 24% and Nvidia Reclaims $5T Market Cap

key_facts.fact: The S&P 500 rose to a new all-time high of 7,164 on Friday, gaining about 0.7%, marking its longest weekly advance since 2024
Nasdaq Composite climbed 1.5% to a record close, while the Dow Jones slipped roughly 0.3%
Intel surged 23.6% — its best single-day performance since October 1987 — after reporting better-than-expected earnings and issuing an upbeat outlook; the stock is up 124% YTD
Nvidia closed at a record $208.27, pushing its market cap back above $5 trillion and reclaiming the title of world's most valuable publicly traded company
Markets were buoyed by optimism around possible US-Iran peace negotiations in Pakistan and strong corporate earnings season

stories.headline: Taiwan's Stock Market Surpasses UK at $4.3T as AI Chip Boom Reshuffles Global Equity Rankings

key_facts.fact: Taiwan's stock market, valued at nearly $4.3 trillion, surpassed the United Kingdom — Europe's biggest market — earlier this month
South Korea is about $140 billion away from also surpassing the UK; both Asian markets have shot past Germany and France in the past seven months
TSMC shares have climbed more than 40% this year, while Samsung and SK Hynix have surged more than 80% each
TSMC's market cap stands at $1.8 trillion, while Samsung and SK Hynix combined at $1.5 trillion — all individually larger than Europe's biggest tech company, ASML
The combined market cap of all technology stocks in the Stoxx Europe 600 Index stands at about $1.4 trillion, less than TSMC alone

stories.headline: AI Chip Boom Pushes Taiwan and South Korea Past UK in Global Equity Rankings

key_facts.fact: Taiwan's stock market value has surpassed the UK's at approximately $4.3 trillion, with South Korea close behind
The tech-heavy Asian markets have shot past Germany and France in the past seven months, driven by TSMC, Samsung, and SK Hynix
The reshuffling is driven by massive gains in semiconductor and AI hardware companies concentrated in Taiwan and Korea

stories.headline: Trump Sends Witkoff and Kushner to Pakistan for New Iran Talks as Araghchi Arrives in Islamabad

key_facts.fact: President Trump is sending envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to Islamabad on Saturday for talks with Iran, with VP JD Vance on 'standby'
Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi landed in Islamabad on Friday but did not confirm direct talks with the US
Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth said the US blockade on Iranian ports will remain in place 'until necessary'
Israel and Lebanon agreed to extend the ceasefire by three weeks, Trump announced on Thursday
The US froze $344 million in cryptocurrency assets linked to Iran as part of its pressure campaign on Tehran
This is the second attempt at peace talks; the first round in Islamabad was led by VP Vance nearly two weeks ago

stories.headline: Amazon-Backed Nuclear Startup X-Energy Raises $1.02B in Upsized IPO, Surges 31% on Debut

key_facts.fact: X-Energy priced IPO at $23/share, well above the marketed range of $16-$19, selling 44.3 million shares to raise $1.02 billion
Shares surged 30.9% in the Nasdaq debut, fetching a valuation of $11.9 billion
X-Energy develops the Xe-100, a small modular reactor cooled by helium rather than water, and manufactures its own TRISO fuel
Amazon invested roughly $500 million in X-Energy in 2024 to accelerate SMR deployment; company has deals with Dow and Centrica
Last year's financials showed ~$94M revenue against $390M in losses; a 2023 SPAC listing attempt was abandoned
